name: wandavision
description: Bundles the mcp-vision MCP server and enforces deterministic, pixel-accurate reads of every image — user-submitted or tool-generated — instead of LLM guesswork. Runtime files (wrapper script, skill body, OpenCode reminder hook) live in the XDG data directory ~/.local/share/com.jcchikikomori.llmworkflow/wandavision/ and are shared with OpenCode; this marketplace plugin is a thin shim.
